summary: Threat actors are conducting device code phishing campaigns to steal Microsoft 365 tokens by abusing infrastructure from VPS reseller BL Networks. This activity follows a similar playbook to an earlier campaign that abused the Railway PaaS, indicating an evolving threat that leverages legitimate-looking infrastructure for token replay attacks.
